Add 1d8 to your check against a card that has the (☐ Cold or) Undead trait.
At the start of your turn, you may draw a card.
You may put an ally that has the Undead trait on top of your deck to add 1d10 to a combat (☐ or Strength, Constitution, or Perception) check by another character at your location.
